items.title: Technical Adaptability
items.subtitle: Adapting to different technologies and digital tools.
items.description: I can learn unfamiliar platforms, navigate digital systems, and work across websites, content management systems, and other business tools.

items.title: AI-Ready Workflows
items.subtitle: Using AI with purpose, not just prompting.
items.description: I use AI to support research, develop ideas, assist with visual creation, and work through digital tasks—with clear instructions and human review.

items.title: Process Improvement
items.subtitle: Always looking for a better way to get things done.
items.description: I look for practical ways to improve existing processes, simplify workflows, and make systems easier to use and manage.

items.title: Clear Communication
items.subtitle: Keeping you informed without having to ask for updates.
items.description: I communicate progress, share relevant updates, and ask questions when something is unclear—so you always know where things stand and what to expect next.
